rationale: Generic breakfast cereal category item. Oatmeal exists but cornflakes/muesli/granola are distinct items that warrant a generic container. Currently oatmeal is being overloaded with cornflakes/muesli aliases which is semantically incorrect.

rationale: Muesli is a distinct breakfast item (raw rolled grains + fruit + nuts) very different from both oatmeal (hot porridge) and granola (baked). Hamster Food Muesli (hamster_food_muesli) is what currently matches müsli searches — this is actively wrong.
review_note: High priority: müsli is a core staple in German-speaking markets

rationale: Cornflakes are one of the most common grocery items typed in lists but absent from seed. Should be a top-level item, not an alias of oatmeal.
